title: Aloo Paratha
description: Whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potato and pan-fried with ghee — a hearty breakfast bread, usually served with curd and pickle.
steps: Knead the flour, water and salt into a soft dough, cover and rest for 15-20 minutes.
Mix the mashed potato with the onion, green chilli, ginger, coriander leaves, cumin powder, amchur, red chilli powder and salt to taste.
Divide the dough into 8 balls and the potato filling into 8 portions. Roll a dough ball into a small disc, place a portion of filling in the centre, and gather the edges to seal.
Gently flatten and roll out the stuffed ball into a paratha about 6 inches across, dusting with flour as needed and taking care not to let the filling spill out.
Heat a tawa over medium heat. Cook the paratha for about a minute, then flip and drizzle a little ghee on top.
Flip again and drizzle ghee on the other side, pressing gently with a spatula until both sides are golden brown and crisp, 3-4 minutes total.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling. Serve hot with curd, pickle, or butter.
